tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background for parent screens and onboarding.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Content cards and list groups on bg. Never glass.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between ListRows; decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surface (12.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and values on bg and surface (5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active tab, links on bg and surface; white text on it (4.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: primary-press
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed state.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted icon tiles and info banners; primary text on it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting fills (child avatars, chips). Always with on-secondary text.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on secondary (7.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: reward
tokens.usage: Stickers, badges, streak flame. Never used for warnings.

tokens.name: on-reward
tokens.usage: Text on reward (5.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Missed brushing zone only (MouthMap + its results legend). Nothing else.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and the retry glyph on warning (8.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a missed zone, at least 3:1 on session-bg.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: PARENT SCREENS ONLY: destructive actions and errors. Never shown in kid mode.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Icon tile behind a destructive row.
